original: 稀溶液中某离子的摩尔电化学势可写 \(\mu =\mu ^{0}+RT \ln c+zF\phi\)。它与单粒子 Boltzmann 写法完全等价：单离子电荷 \(q_{c}=z e\)，\(R=N_{Ak,B}\)，\(F=N_{Ae}\)，所以 \(RT/(zF)=k_{\mathrm{BT}}/q_{c}\)。平衡浓度比可写 \(c_{\mathrm{out}}/c_{\mathrm{in}}=\exp(q_{c}E/k_{\mathrm{BT}})\)，取对数后就是 \(E_{\mathrm{ion}}=V_{\mathrm{in}}-V_{\mathrm{out}}=(RT/zF)\ln(c_{\mathrm{out}}/c_{\mathrm{in}})\)。阳离子 \(z>0\) 保留对数符号；\(\mathrm{Cl}^{-}\) 的 \(z=-1\) 会反转符号。
expected: 稀溶液中某离子的摩尔电化学势可写 \(\mu =\mu ^{0}+RT \ln c+zF\phi\)。它与单粒子 Boltzmann 写法完全等价：单离子电荷 \(q_{c}=z e\)，\(R=N_{A} k_{B}\)，\(F=N_{A} e\)，所以 \(RT/(zF)=k_{B}T/q_{c}\)。平衡浓度比可写 \(c_{\mathrm{out}}/c_{\mathrm{in}}=\exp(q_{c}E/(k_{B}T))\)，取对数后就是 \(E_{\mathrm{ion}}=V_{\mathrm{in}}-V_{\mathrm{out}}=(RT/zF)\ln(c_{\mathrm{out}}/c_{\mathrm{in}})\)。阳离子 \(z>0\) 保留对数符号；\(\mathrm{Cl}^{-}\) 的 \(z=-1\) 会反转符号。

original: 用 \(q_{c}=z e\)、\(R=N_{Ak,B}\)、\(F=N_{Ae}\) 可把摩尔能量除以 Avogadro 常数，得到 \(RT/(zF)=k_{\mathrm{BT}}/q_{c}\)。于是 Boltzmann 浓度比与摩尔 Nernst 式是同一步物理平衡的两种单位系统。
expected: 用 \(q_{c}=z e\)、\(R=N_{A} k_{B}\)、\(F=N_{A} e\) 可把摩尔能量除以 Avogadro 常数，得到 \(RT/(zF)=k_{B}T/q_{c}\)。于是 Boltzmann 浓度比与摩尔 Nernst 式是同一步物理平衡的两种单位系统。

original: 利用 \(E[K]=\operatorname{Var}(K)=r\Delta t\)，得到 \(E[Q]=(N_{\mathrm{EW},Er,E}-N_{\mathrm{IW},Ir,I})\Delta t\)；独立性给 \(\operatorname{Var}(Q)=(N_{\mathrm{EW},E}^{2}r_{E}+N_{\mathrm{IW},I}^{2}r_{I})\Delta t\)。均值可以由 E/I 抵消，方差不能因正负号直接抵消。若输入间相关，还需加入成对协方差，独立公式将低估或改变波动。
expected: 利用 \(E[K]=\operatorname{Var}(K)=r\Delta t\)，得到 \(E[Q]=(N_{E} W_{E} r_{E}-N_{I} W_{I} r_{I})\Delta t\)；独立性给 \(\operatorname{Var}(Q)=(N_{E} W_{E}^{2}r_{E}+N_{I} W_{I}^{2}r_{I})\Delta t\)。均值可以由 E/I 抵消，方差不能因正负号直接抵消。若输入间相关，还需加入成对协方差，独立公式将低估或改变波动。
formulas: E[Q]=(N_{E} W_{E} r_{E}-N_{I} W_{I} r_{I})\Delta t

original: 输入标准差为 \(O(N^{-1}/^{2})\)，大 N 下电压主要响应确定平均，随机越阈机会消失。
expected: 输入标准差为 \(O(N^{-1/2})\)，大 N 下电压主要响应确定平均，随机越阈机会消失。

original: 若权重按 \(W\sim 1/\sqrt N\)，方差 \(N W^{2}\sim O(1)\)，所以总输入标准差在 N 增大时保持有限。代价是每一类均值 \(N W\sim \sqrt N\)：兴奋与抑制单独都很大。要让净均值仍为 \(O(1)\)，必须满足领先阶平衡 \(N_{\mathrm{EW},Er,E}\approx N_{\mathrm{IW},Ir,I}\)，使两个 \(O(\sqrt N)\) 项相消，只留下有限残差。
expected: 若权重按 \(W\sim 1/\sqrt N\)，方差 \(N W^{2}\sim O(1)\)，所以总输入标准差在 N 增大时保持有限。代价是每一类均值 \(N W\sim \sqrt N\)：兴奋与抑制单独都很大。要让净均值仍为 \(O(1)\)，必须满足领先阶平衡 \(N_{E} W_{E} r_{E}\approx N_{I} W_{I} r_{I}\)，使两个 \(O(\sqrt N)\) 项相消，只留下有限残差。
formulas: N_{E} W_{E} r_{E}\approx N_{I} W_{I} r_{I}

original: 令 \(N_{E}=a_{\mathrm{EN}}\)、\(N_{I}=a_{\mathrm{IN}}\)，\(W_{E}=w_{E}/\sqrt N\)、\(W_{I}=w_{I}/\sqrt N\)，率与 \(\Delta t\) 不随 N 改变。
expected: 令 \(N_{E}=a_{E} N\)、\(N_{I}=a_{I} N\)，\(W_{E}=w_{E}/\sqrt N\)、\(W_{I}=w_{I}/\sqrt N\)，率与 \(\Delta t\) 不随 N 改变。

original: E 类平均为 \(a_{E}\sqrt N\) \(w_{Er,E}\Delta t\)，I 类类似，净均值的领先阶为 \(\sqrt N\) 乘二者差。
expected: E 类平均为 \(a_{E}\sqrt N\) \(w_{E} r_{E}\Delta t\)，I 类类似，净均值的领先阶为 \(\sqrt N\) 乘二者差。

original: 为避免净均值发散，要求 \(a_{Ew,Er,E}-a_{Iw,Ir,I}=O(N^{-1/2})\)；极限主项相等。
expected: 为避免净均值发散，要求 \(a_{E} w_{E} r_{E}-a_{I} w_{I} r_{I}=O(N^{-1/2})\)；极限主项相等。

original: For a dilute solution, the molar electrochemical potential of an ion is \(\mu =\mu ^{0}+RT \ln c+zF\phi\). This is equivalent to the single-particle Boltzmann form in the source: \(q_{c}=z e\), \(R=N_{Ak,B}\), and \(F=N_{Ae}\), so \(RT/(zF)=k_{\mathrm{BT}}/q_{c}\). At equilibrium, \(c_{\mathrm{out}}/c_{\mathrm{in}}=\exp(q_{c}E/k_{\mathrm{BT}})\); taking the logarithm gives \(E_{\mathrm{ion}}=V_{\mathrm{in}}-V_{\mathrm{out}}=(RT/zF)\ln(c_{\mathrm{out}}/c_{\mathrm{in}})\). For a cation, \(z>0\) preserves the logarithm's sign. For \(\mathrm{Cl}^{-}\), \(z=-1\) reverses it.
expected: For a dilute solution, the molar electrochemical potential of an ion is \(\mu =\mu ^{0}+RT \ln c+zF\phi\). This is equivalent to the single-particle Boltzmann form in the source: \(q_{c}=z e\), \(R=N_{A} k_{B}\), and \(F=N_{A} e\), so \(RT/(zF)=k_{B}T/q_{c}\). At equilibrium, \(c_{\mathrm{out}}/c_{\mathrm{in}}=\exp(q_{c}E/(k_{B}T))\); taking the logarithm gives \(E_{\mathrm{ion}}=V_{\mathrm{in}}-V_{\mathrm{out}}=(RT/zF)\ln(c_{\mathrm{out}}/c_{\mathrm{in}})\). For a cation, \(z>0\) preserves the logarithm's sign. For \(\mathrm{Cl}^{-}\), \(z=-1\) reverses it.

original: Using \(q_{c}=z e\), \(R=N_{Ak,B}\), and \(F=N_{Ae}\), divide molar energy by Avogadro's constant to obtain \(RT/(zF)=k_{\mathrm{BT}}/q_{c}\). Thus, the Boltzmann concentration ratio and the molar Nernst equation express the same physical equilibrium in two unit systems.
expected: Using \(q_{c}=z e\), \(R=N_{A} k_{B}\), and \(F=N_{A} e\), divide molar energy by Avogadro's constant to obtain \(RT/(zF)=k_{B}T/q_{c}\). Thus, the Boltzmann concentration ratio and the molar Nernst equation express the same physical equilibrium in two unit systems.

original: Using \(E[K]=\operatorname{Var}(K)=r\Delta t\) gives \(E[Q]=(N_{\mathrm{EW},Er,E}-N_{\mathrm{IW},Ir,I})\Delta t\). Independence gives \(\operatorname{Var}(Q)=(N_{\mathrm{EW},E}^{2}r_{E}+N_{\mathrm{IW},I}^{2}r_{I})\Delta t\). E/I contributions can cancel in the mean, but their variances cannot cancel merely because their signs differ. If inputs are correlated, pairwise covariance terms must be added and the independent formula may underestimate or otherwise alter the fluctuations.
expected: Using \(E[K]=\operatorname{Var}(K)=r\Delta t\) gives \(E[Q]=(N_{E} W_{E} r_{E}-N_{I} W_{I} r_{I})\Delta t\). Independence gives \(\operatorname{Var}(Q)=(N_{E} W_{E}^{2}r_{E}+N_{I} W_{I}^{2}r_{I})\Delta t\). E/I contributions can cancel in the mean, but their variances cannot cancel merely because their signs differ. If inputs are correlated, pairwise covariance terms must be added and the independent formula may underestimate or otherwise alter the fluctuations.
formulas: E[Q]=(N_{E} W_{E} r_{E}-N_{I} W_{I} r_{I})\Delta t

original: Input standard deviation is \(O(N^{-1}/^{2})\). At large N, voltage responds mainly to the deterministic mean and random threshold crossings disappear.
expected: Input standard deviation is \(O(N^{-1/2})\). At large N, voltage responds mainly to the deterministic mean and random threshold crossings disappear.

original: If weights scale as \(W\sim 1/\sqrt N\), variance \(N W^{2}\sim O(1)\), so total-input standard deviation remains finite as N grows. The cost is that each population \(\operatorname{mean} N W\sim \sqrt N\) becomes large. For the net mean to stay \(O(1)\), leading-order balance \(N_{\mathrm{EW},Er,E}\approx N_{\mathrm{IW},Ir,I}\) is required: two \(O(\sqrt N)\) terms cancel and leave only a finite residual.
expected: If weights scale as \(W\sim 1/\sqrt N\), variance \(N W^{2}\sim O(1)\), so total-input standard deviation remains finite as N grows. The cost is that each population \(\operatorname{mean} N W\sim \sqrt N\) becomes large. For the net mean to stay \(O(1)\), leading-order balance \(N_{E} W_{E} r_{E}\approx N_{I} W_{I} r_{I}\) is required: two \(O(\sqrt N)\) terms cancel and leave only a finite residual.
formulas: N_{E} W_{E} r_{E}\approx N_{I} W_{I} r_{I}

original: Let \(N_{E}=a_{\mathrm{EN}}\), \(N_{I}=a_{\mathrm{IN}}\), \(W_{E}=w_{E}/\sqrt N\), and \(W_{I}=w_{I}/\sqrt N\), while rates and \(\Delta t\) remain independent of N.
expected: Let \(N_{E}=a_{E} N\), \(N_{I}=a_{I} N\), \(W_{E}=w_{E}/\sqrt N\), and \(W_{I}=w_{I}/\sqrt N\), while rates and \(\Delta t\) remain independent of N.

original: The E-population mean is \(a_{E}\sqrt N\) \(w_{Er,E}\Delta t\), with an analogous I-population term. The leading net mean is \(\sqrt N\) times their difference.
expected: The E-population mean is \(a_{E}\sqrt N\) \(w_{E} r_{E}\Delta t\), with an analogous I-population term. The leading net mean is \(\sqrt N\) times their difference.

original: To prevent divergence of the net mean, require \(a_{Ew,Er,E}-a_{Iw,Ir,I}=O(N^{-1/2})\); the leading terms are equal in the limit.
expected: To prevent divergence of the net mean, require \(a_{E} w_{E} r_{E}-a_{I} w_{I} r_{I}=O(N^{-1/2})\); the leading terms are equal in the limit.
\(N_{E} W_{E}^{2}=a_{E} N\cdot w_{E}^{2}/N=a_{E} w_{E}^{2}\), so N disappears.
